verdict.rationale: INPI's own pages publish some exact time figures: 10-year renewal cycles, 20/10-year patent and utility-model terms with annuities due, 6-month publication timing, 1–30 month deferment, and a 6-month maximum suspension. However, the pack contains no penalty, surcharge, late-fee or interest schedule for missed deadlines, and no fee amounts at all. Missing for 10: published penalty/surcharge and interest figures for missed deadlines, exact annuity and renewal fee amounts with due dates and grace periods, and a consolidated filing-deadline schedule.
